🚜 NOW ACCEPTING CONSIGNMENTS 🚜

Our December Equipment & Vehicle Auction is Thursday, December 3, live and online, and we're building the sale now. If you've got equipment sitting idle, this is the time to turn it into cash before the end of the year.

WHAT WE'RE TAKING
• Tractors of every size, vintage to modern cab models
• Loaders, skid steers and construction equipment
• Trucks, cars and other vehicles
• Trailers, hay and farm implements
• Shop tools and equipment

WHY CONSIGN WITH MATTHEWS
• Live bidders on sale day plus online bidders from across the country
• Three generations of auction experience, since 2004
• Free consultation with no fees or commitments to talk it through

Already consigned: tractors, loaders, a skid steer, trailers and hay equipment, with more coming in every week. One piece or a whole barn full, we want to hear from you.

Live & online Equipment & Vehicle Auction: Thursday, December 3 at 10 AM ET. To consign, call or text Daniel at (276) 266-1265 for a free, no-obligation consultation. Drop-offs Monday–Thursday at 299 E Virginia St, Galax, VA.
